lines.serbian: Tijana svako jutro ide autobusom na posao.
lines.croatian: Tijana svako jutro ide autobusom na posao.
lines.english: Every morning Tijana takes the bus to work.
She always has her headphones on.
Today she plays her favourite song.

lines.serbian: Muzika je glasna i Tijana je srećna.
lines.croatian: Glazba je glasna i Tijana je sretna.
lines.english: The music is loud and Tijana is happy.
She closes her eyes and sings quietly.
Then she sings a little louder.

lines.serbian: Glava joj se pomera u ritmu.
lines.croatian: Glava joj se pomiče u ritmu.
lines.english: Her head moves to the rhythm.

lines.serbian: Dolazi refren. Tijana peva iz sveg glasa.
lines.croatian: Dolazi refren. Tijana pjeva iz sveg glasa.
lines.english: The chorus comes. Tijana sings at the top of her voice.
The whole bus is looking at her.
A little boy is filming her on a phone.

lines.serbian: Tijana skida slušalice. Lice joj je crveno.
lines.croatian: Tijana skida slušalice. Lice joj je crveno.
lines.english: Tijana takes off her headphones. Her face is red.

lines.serbian: Stariji čovek pored nje se naginje.
lines.croatian: Stariji čovjek pored nje se naginje.
lines.english: An older man next to her leans over.

lines.serbian: – Unuka je stalno sluša. Ali ona peva bolje.
lines.croatian: – Unuka je stalno sluša. Ali ona pjeva bolje.
lines.english: "My granddaughter listens to it all the time. But she sings better."

lines.serbian: Tijana se smeje, stavlja slušalice i ćuti do kraja puta.
lines.croatian: Tijana se smije, stavlja slušalice i šuti do kraja puta.
lines.english: Tijana laughs, puts her headphones on and stays quiet for the rest of the trip.
